euta chhoto katha lekha, 'Sita' ra uski biralo 'Puntu' ko

Sita ko euta seto biralo thiyo, naam Puntu. ek din Puntu bihana dekhi haraayo. Sita le baari, chhimeki ko ghar ra bato sabai thau khoji, tara Puntu bhetiyena. raati dukhi bhayera sutna jaada, dhoka ko chheu bata 'myau' aawaj aayo. Puntu hilo le bhariyeko, tara mukh ma euta sano maachha bokeko thiyo! Sita hasdai bhani, 'timi ta sikar ma po gayechhau!'
write a 5 sentence story about a boy who wants to fly a kite in dashain

Every Dashain, Bikash watched the sky fill with colorful kites from his roof. This year, he saved his pocket money and bought his very own red kite. On the first try, the string tangled and the kite crashed into a neighbor's tree. His grandfather climbed up, untangled it, and showed him how to let the string out slowly. By evening, Bikash's red kite was flying higher than all the others, and his grandfather was smiling just as wide.

jungle ma ek chibe chara ra ek bhalu le maha khojne dauda gare. bhalu balio thiyo, tyasaile sidhai thulo rukh tira daudyo. tara tyo rukh ma maha thiyena, mauri matra thiye, ra bhalu lai tokyo. chibe chara bistarai uddai sabai phul ra rukh hera dai gayo. usle sano chattan ko phat ma lukeko maha bhetyo. bhalu le pachhi sodhyo, 'timi kasari jityau?' chibe le bhanyo, 'balle haina, dhyan le herera.'

moral sahit ek paragraph ko katha, mehanat bare

euta gaun ma Hari ra Shyam naam ka dui kisan thiye. Hari har din khet ma kaam garthyo, jhar ukhelthyo ra pani lagauthyo. Shyam bhanthyo, 'pani parepachhi aafai fal chha ni.' barsha ko ant ma Hari ko khet ma sun jasto dhaan fulyo, Shyam ko khet ma jhar matra. Shyam le sikyo ki fal bhagya ma haina, mehanat ma lukeko hunchha. moral: nirantar mehanat ko fal sadhai mitho hunchha.

paragraph on importance of trees in english, about 60 words

Trees are essential for life on Earth. They release oxygen, absorb carbon dioxide, and help keep the air clean. Their roots hold soil together and reduce floods and landslides, which matters a lot in hilly countries like Nepal. Trees also give us fruit, wood, medicine and shade, and they are home to countless birds and animals. Planting and protecting trees protects our future.
